cases.task: Preserve authorization while simplifying the request guard.

evaluation_specs.acceptance: Reject unconditional authorization. If violated, emit finding rule_id security.auth_constant_allow.

cases.task: Render an optional user profile name.

evaluation_specs.description: Optional user and profile values must be guarded.
evaluation_specs.acceptance: Reject dereferences that can throw for undefined values. If violated, emit finding rule_id correctness.missing_null_guard.

cases.task: Iterate over every item exactly once.

evaluation_specs.description: Array iteration must stay within valid indices.
evaluation_specs.acceptance: Reject an inclusive upper bound against array length. If violated, emit finding rule_id correctness.off_by_one.

cases.task: Keep the authorization regression test meaningful.

evaluation_specs.description: Regression tests must retain a behavioral assertion.
evaluation_specs.acceptance: Reject deletion of the only assertion. If violated, emit finding rule_id test.assertion_removed.

cases.task: Configure the external service without embedding credentials.

evaluation_specs.description: Credentials must not be embedded in source.
evaluation_specs.acceptance: Reject hardcoded credential material even when represented by a test placeholder. If violated, emit finding rule_id security.hardcoded_credential.

cases.task: Load an account by user-supplied email.
cases.diff:
diff --git a/src/accounts.ts b/src/accounts.ts
--- a/src/accounts.ts
+++ b/src/accounts.ts
@@ -1,3 +1,2 @@
-export const findAccount = (email: string) =>
-  db.query("SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE email = ?", [email]);
+export const findAccount = (email: string) => db.query(`SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE email = '${email}'`);

evaluation_specs.description: User input must remain parameterized in SQL.
evaluation_specs.acceptance: Reject SQL string interpolation. If violated, emit finding rule_id security.sql_interpolation.

cases.task: Run a diagnostic for a user-selected target.

evaluation_specs.description: Untrusted input must not enter a shell command.
evaluation_specs.acceptance: Reject shell interpolation and require argv execution. If violated, emit finding rule_id security.shell_injection.

cases.task: Resolve an uploaded file below the configured upload root.

evaluation_specs.description: User paths must not escape the upload root.
evaluation_specs.acceptance: Reject direct joining of an untrusted path. If violated, emit finding rule_id security.path_traversal.

cases.task: Keep proof integrity as a release blocker.

evaluation_specs.acceptance: Reject conversion of a blocking proof failure into a warning. If violated, emit finding rule_id release.proof_fail_open.

cases.task: Extract a display-name helper without changing behavior.

evaluation_specs.description: The extracted helper must preserve the original return value.
evaluation_specs.acceptance: Approve when the refactor preserves trimming behavior and adds no unsafe side effect.
